notes.title: Baklava Simulator Big New Update
notes.content:
1-) [b]Sleep And Save[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038896/e2aa5f724da42acc67a4fbde5829a49f4bc9fb4c.png[/img]


[u]The new registration system will register when the character lies from now on.[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038896/e38c21470890b220df23246a4409e80b0cd210b1.png[/img]

[u]You can block the thief by punching her.[/u]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038896/5b3a6736ee700943fed53208c5681fb461cd5f57.png[/img]

[u]Now you can leave the store open on your computer and close it whenever you want.[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038896/1d4fe60302db7d1d72121d27dc255b8d1a1970a6.png[/img]


[u]Smoke will come out from broken systems. It will go away when you fix it.[/u]

[u]Garbage collection system. You can automatically pick up the garbage by buying a garbage collector from the market.[/u]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038896/5aba3a71208eb60fe3c556016b6defca0ed53d51.png[/img]

[u]Added social media to the menu.[/u]
[u]Added link to the menu where they can find Updates.[/u]

9-) [b]You can follow us for more. You can check for updates...[/b]

notes.title: Baklava Simulator Big New Update
notes.content:
1-) [b]Main Menu[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038896/08d2aac92d2b8c19c2c149123d8a30eba6177393.png[/img]

[u]A new interface system has been made. Their designs have been changed.[/u]

[u]New character selection screen and design has been made.[/u]

In the new character selection screen, you will be able to choose your character as we want and choose the color tone.


3-) [b]Settings Menu[/b]

[u] A new graphic system and design was made.[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038896/788ab7065aca9082fe278c4b358d8cf10f7e8296.png[/img]

[u]The new general settings system has been made and the design has been changed.[/u]

[u]The new key system was made and the design was changed.[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038896/9a2720bc20b68715826343c19c8d323834efb1c9.png[/img]


4-) [b]Upgrade Menu[/b]

[u]A new upgrade system and design has been made.[/u]

With the new upgrade system, you can help your staff work faster by paying them more. You can reduce the repair rate by making your materials of high quality. You can attract customers by increasing the popularity of your grocery store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038896/227a15d6eb4b5207ba03af98fa1a9ba15812f4f3.png[/img]

5-) [b]Car configuration Menu[/b]

[u]Car Configuratioın new system and  desing [/u]

You will be able to choose the color tone you want by bringing your vehicle to the garage here. The new system, the wheel of your vehicle, etc. will be replaced, the system will come soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038896/df247e2cd0f6cf865cf7fe8f3ef35ba7b375c5fd.png[/img]

6-) [b]Food Menu[/b]

[u]New Food system and desing[/u]

this place can help fill your stomach.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038896/acddbe9fa1345c22828dc58295e3a0701ef9d8a3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038896/40c0667e2e4c13d5cf4e3fdff4e736d2af0bf37c.png[/img]

[u]There will be more people in the city than before.[/u]

Now you can see extra people everywhere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038896/56c54aa1f354a787537e35f1cdf1d1d98387db7d.png[/img]



8-) [b]Thief [/b]

[u]new thief system[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038896/95a29773536b76218a80de6de37593edaf9f5c6d.png[/img]

The new thief system will now approach your safe and steal your money. If you catch him, he will go away.

[u]New estante agent system and desing[/u]

The new real estate agent company now owns the baklava store, garages, your new homes, etc. You can get things here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038896/ad2113cdb999471b88dbf5655bc4c8e04426e6bc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41038896/f7a2cb5c4311afff6ce15836e4981d7a914b88ab.png[/img]

You can buy the product. The drawn bank can control the loans. and will help with issues such as upgrades.

notes.title: Baklava Simulator New Update Version 0.3
notes.content:
New Tutorial :  A tutorial window will appear and explain the things you will interact with in the game.

New Sky : The new sky system was installed.

New Car widget : Changed the popup window when going to buy a vehicle. New systems have been added.

Optimization done.

New Car Configuration : The car customization system has been fixed.

New Disco Update : disco system was organized. When you enter inside, it has been made to be turned on and off with the E key.
